environment: Actual native Android modules in an AOSP Android 16 emulator with host audio disabled; local HTTPS/API and real caregiver browsers; scripted interpretation and fixture tone replies. No real speech or acoustic audibility evidence.

checks.name: Resumed previously paired native verification installation
Native alert is scheduled for the exact dose before entering battery-saver state
Android posts the exact generic alert in battery-saver state without recording a dose
Actual battery-saver notification tap opens the native app and remains separate from medication reporting

original.full_policy:
advertise_is_enabled=true
    disable_vibration=false
    disable_animation=false
    defer_full_backup=true
    defer_keyvalue_backup=true
    enable_firewall=true
    enable_datasaver=false
    disable_launch_boost=true
    enable_brightness_adjustment=false
    adjust_brightness_factor=0.5
    location_mode=3
    force_all_apps_standby=true
    force_background_check=true
    disable_optional_sensors=true
    disable_aod=true
    soundtrigger_mode=1
    enable_quick_doze=true
    enable_night_mode=true

power.note: Real Android Battery Saver/background policy with simulated unplugged 15% battery on a disposable emulator. No physical battery-life, consumption, OEM or acoustic evidence.
